tests.scope_and_limits: Preview and reversible edits, no repository hooks.

Declared profiles and local admission; unknown profile is an explicit error; no live-provider certification.
Malformed native JSONL rejected, terminal-after-terminal rejected; MCP/native fixtures, not all agent protocols.
Real terminal detach/reattach while local supervisor lives.
Stale-heartbeat local fencing (Reconcile marks LOST on darwin/Linux); no cross-host migration.
Process and request cancellation; does not reverse side effects.
Local global budget ledger (Charge/SetBudgetCap) enforced atomically; no fleet-wide billing.
Local budget cap refused charges leave ledger unchanged; no complete global disk quota.
Double identical content reads frozen bytes; post-capture mutation detected; not a filesystem-atomic transaction.
Unsupported special/oversized source states refused; consistency label states exact limits.
Port/db named-reservation coordination tested; no OS-level binding or container isolation.
Cycle detection, exact predecessor artifacts and final re-verification.
Frozen config binding: run pins the loaded plan and refuses same-key different-contract reuse; no schedules/webhooks.
Idempotent workflow/task keys with concurrent CreateOnce coverage; no schedules/webhook integration.
API/project checks, not OS-level multi-tenant isolation.
Untrusted tool input cannot approve/grant; no real model prompt-injection benchmark.

Docker flag admission gated locally (refuses without fallback when daemon absent); functional restricted-docker smoke ran a pinned alpine@sha256 container on a local daemon from Linux; still no independent trusted host, no cred broker, no security certification.
No silent local fallback; restricted-docker ran a real pinned container on the local daemon from Linux (smoke, not certification).
Exact local review identity; not organization-authenticated human approval.
Required result completeness and structured parser errors.
Generic command outcome not promoted to stronger tool semantics.
Retained snapshot integrity and local replay (Replay re-runs frozen candidate+config); no general remote evidence import.
Named failure signature, base/candidate outcome, setup ambiguity rejected.
Failed attempts remain linked; no cherry-picking prior candidate evidence.

Empty required plan remains inconclusive.
Local advisory publisher (publish --id --to DIR) writes to filesystem; not a protected CI gate. Remote client has no blind retries (explicit). Not external delivery.
Local heartbeat fencing (Reconcile marks LOST, revokes leases). No remote-host fencing.
Composed source checked; external provider merge queue not implemented.
Local advisory publisher (publish --id --to DIR) writes to filesystem; not a protected independent CI gate.

Online backup/new-state restore, no public auto-updater or interrupted-version rollout.

Explicit attributed/synthetic/unknown labels; no merge-to-correctness inference.
Candidate disjointness and reuse tracking; full external dataset-access governance pending.

Bounded reports, path/digest validation and sanitized human text (logs/report strip raw ESC/NUL/CR; lone CSI byte surfaces as harmless U+FFFD); JSON renders preserve raw evidence bytes with valid encoding; not complete security certification.
No acceptance cache reuse: outcomes credited only against exact stored candidate evidence.
No destructive delivery tool exists; absence is correct by design, not approval.
Evidence export and reversible instructions; full installer/uninstaller not present.
